description: brickwork catalogue taxonomy (plan decision D8): family, kind, archetype/section usage and doc pointers for every shipped shell, component, section example and archetype example. A sibling of template-manifest.json, never merged into it: this file is descriptive catalogue metadata, not a BR-BW-VER-001 semver contract, and may evolve in minors (D8). 'family' is a catalogue taxonomy field only (O1): it is never a package API identifier. 'families' lists shipped-coverage package truth only (which families have shipped items, and how many); it carries no planned/wave status, which is roadmap truth read from ROADMAP.md instead (see docs/CATALOGUE.md section 8). Generated by scripts/generate_catalogue_manifest.py from the shipped template and examples trees; do not edit by hand.
